messages:
maya r.: hi all — first week! quick Q: where's the canonical place for onboarding docs & team playbooks? i tried searching Notion and found a few copies. also need edit access to the engineering onboarding template.

alex (DevEx): welcome maya :party_parrot: the single source is the 'Company Docs' workspace in Notion. main index is /Company Home/Onboarding. templates live in /Company Home/Templates/Onboarding-Templates.

maya r.: thanks — can you paste a link? i only see some old 'eng-onboard v0' pages.

alex (DevEx): sure — https://notion.so/redwood-company/Company-Home-xxxxx (link shortened). open the Templates page, then click the "Use this template" button to create a copy in your workspace.

maya r.: got it. when i try to duplicate i get a "no permission to duplicate" error.

devex-bot: If you hit permission errors for Notion, request access via the docs-support form: https://redwood.internal/docs-support. Requests are routed to the Docs team and People Ops.

sam (Docs Owner): hey @maya r. — I just checked your account. You need to be in the `redwood-employees` SSO group and the `editors` Notion group. I can add you if People Ops confirms your role.

jordan (People Ops): Confirmed — maya is onboarded today (orientation done). @sam I approve adding to editors.

sam (Docs Owner): done. you should have edit rights now, try duplicating the template again.

maya r.: works now, thanks! quick follow-up: should I create a personal copy under "My Space" or put team-level copies under /Engineering/Onboarding?

tia: put any role-specific checklists under /Engineering/Onboarding/Teams/<your-team>. The global checklist (what People Ops needs) should be under /Company Home/Onboarding/Global-Checklists and reference the team page.

maya r.: perfect. last thing — are there any naming conventions or metadata we should add to the page?

alex (DevEx): yes please. add these properties to the top of the page: `Owner` (mention your name), `Team` (select), `Onboarded` (date when completed), and `TemplateVersion` (semver like `v1.0.0`). if this is a team page, add `Visibility: team` tag.

maya r.: will do. thanks everyone! :raised_hands:

sam (Docs Owner): thanks for the heads up. if you want i can run a quick checklist review after you publish, ping me with the page link.

maya r.: will do — sending the link shortly.

devex-bot: Note: if you later need an owner change or page transfer, submit via docs-support and include the page URL and desired new owner.
